meta.calibrated_note: readout = the paper's raw J-lens readout unembed(J_l h); lens vectors are always the raw rows of W_U @ J_l
meta.band_note: workspace band = layers [layer-lo, layer-hi] (0-indexed) intersected with the lens's fitted layers; if the intersection is empty (tiny fixture) ALL fitted layers are used and noted

notes.template: introspection/modulation prompts wrap the vendored contents in the repo's chat convention (USER:/ASSISTANT:, x13's PROMPT_TEMPLATE family); assistant turns are separated by the eos token (the literal '</s>' piece becomes tokenizer.eos_token_id when the tokenizer has one); vendored content strings are used verbatim
notes.carrier: The old painting hung crookedly on the wall.
notes.count_focus: While you copy, count the number of characters in each line.
notes.count_ignore: While you copy, ignore the number of characters in each line.
notes.numeric: numeric readout: the top-1 token among single-token leading-space forms of 0..--numeric-max (first value wins on id collisions); error = |value - first line's actual character count|
notes.wrap: line-count passages are re-wrapped greedily at the vendored width (greedy word wrap, single spaces); the numeric ground truth is the FIRST line's actual length
notes.match: concept-reported = word-boundary regex match of the concept's surface form in the generated completion (the fixed prefill is part of the prompt, not the response)
notes.numeric_readout: skipped: this tokenizer yields no single-token numeric forms of 0..99; numeric_mae / numeric_exact_rate are null
